title: Fix two bugs in Flask app: wrong status code and mis-shaped JSON response
description: The Flask items app has two bugs: index() returns HTTP 500 instead of 200, and api_items() wraps the items list in a dict instead of returning the list directly. Both tests fail. Fix the bugs.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix two bugs in src/app.py:

1. index() returns HTTP 500 — remove the explicit status code so Flask returns the default 200:
   return render_template("index.html", items=_items)

2. api_items() wraps _items in a dict instead of returning the list directly:
   return jsonify(_items)

All 2 tests in tests/test_app.py must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: index() returns 200 (no explicit status code override)
api_items() returns a JSON list (not a dict)
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ passes (2 tests)
uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
